systems.country_label: Digitalización del Registro Civil, APP RC
systems.owner: Centro Nacional para la Informatización de la Administración Pública de Guinea Ecuatorial (CNIAPGE)
systems.tiers: not stated; described only as allowing the issue of electronic certificates with QR codes to verify their authenticity
being implemented in the city of Bata, Continental Region; a new system that will allow newborns to be registered from the reference hospitals
all institutions of the national public administration, as stated

note: As of 16 March 2025 CNIAPGE's Director General describes APP RC only by its issue of electronic certificates with QR codes, which is the certificate class, and Pre-registro de Nacimientos as a future system for registering newborns from reference hospitals, under way in Bata with unspecified 'improvements in the Civil Registry'; classed notification on the word pre-registro, though the text says 'registrar' and the parent may read it as civil. Nothing states that an office makes the digital record of a birth or death.
